query:
insert into sellers (id, event_id, name, phone, box_office, goal,
                                  pix_key_type, pix_key, pix_name, pix_city)
           select gen_random_uuid(), $2, name, phone, box_office, goal,
                  pix_key_type, pix_key, pix_name, pix_city
           from sellers where event_id = $1
